name: Can a video pipe inspection help with persistent drain clogs?

mainEntity.name: Can a video pipe inspection help with persistent drain clogs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a video pipe inspection is highly effective for diagnosing persistent drain clogs. Unlike traditional methods that might only clear a blockage temporarily, the camera allows us to see the exact cause of the recurring clog, whether it's tree roots, a collapsed pipe, or significant grease buildup. This visual evidence enables CG Plumbing Solutions to recommend a permanent solution, preventing future clogs and saving you from repeated service calls for the same issue.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, it precisely identifies the cause of recurring clogs like tree roots or collapsed pipes, enabling permanent solutions.
